notes: «جميعا عن ابن عيينة» makes the three co-transmitters one level. The gloss «قال زهير حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة» names the same man, so the fuller form is the link (rule 7).
«ابنى محمد بن علي» is an apposition describing the two sons; the father is written only as «أبيهما» (relation), so Muhammad is not a separate link.
«علي» occurrence 2 is the Companion («عن علي»); occurrence 1 sits inside «محمد بن علي».
